consequence.statement: The -boltdb.shipper.shared-store and -tsdb.shipper.shared-store configuration settings, if present, are no longer honored during upgrade to Loki 3.0.0.

original.statement: The cli-flags -boltdb.shipper.shared-store and -tsdb.shipper.shared-store, and their corresponding YAML configuration keys, have been removed and are no longer honored in Loki 3.0.0; environments that had not configured these settings are unaffected.

decision.reason: [ev-43cc6d389282] says the `-boltdb.shipper.shared-store` and `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store` flags and their YAML settings are removed, and that `object_store` in period_config now decides where the index is stored. So a configured value stops being honoured, which makes setting-ignored the right kind. [ev-7d2769e8c602] and [ev-af5a4b32c120] say that if the value does not match `object_store`, you lose access to the index for those periods until the index tables are moved or copied. That supports mandatory work at high severity. [ev-0483f04624d3] confirms that environments that never set these flags are not affected.
